reuse.why: Moves forecast, updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule and the API field onto the existing getScheduledAmount, but recomputes the approximate tolerance inline instead of calling shared/rules getApproxNumberThreshold, and leaves the preview and template sites on their own midpoint code.

duplication.why: The 7.5% tolerance (Math.round(Math.abs(amount) * 0.075)) is reimplemented inside getScheduledAmount, inline amount copies remain in computeSchedulePreviewTransactions and schedule-template.ts, and two converted sites keep a redundant '== null ? 0' guard the helper already handles.

placement.why: The rule is put in the shared getScheduledAmount in shared/schedules.ts and the API field in api-models.ts, the right layers.

scope.why: Only schedule amount computation, the API field and tests are touched.

maintainability.why: The rule now lives in the helper while computeSchedulePreviewTransactions (whose comment was edited to say 'lowest allowed amount' over unchanged midpoint code) and schedule-template.ts still compute the midpoint, and the tolerance can drift from the matching rule's threshold helper.

bypasses_abstraction.where: shared/schedules.ts getScheduledAmount recomputes the approx tolerance instead of using shared/rules.ts getApproxNumberThreshold; computeSchedulePreviewTransactions and schedule-template.ts keep computing amounts without getScheduledAmount

disguised_duplication.where: getScheduledAmount's 'Math.sign(amount) * Math.round(Math.abs(amount) * 0.075)' is a reshaped copy of getApproxNumberThreshold in shared/rules.ts

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount gains a trailing amountOp parameter; computeSchedulePreviewTransactions (shared/schedules.ts) and createScheduleList (schedule-template.ts) still compute the amount themselves
